plugins.name: claude-code-studios
plugins.description: Full software studio for Claude Code: 45 specialist agents across game AND app/web/service development, 90 workflow skills, and production hooks covering pre-production through live-ops. v0.6.5 gives the runtime-split world an actual reader: `hooks/detect-runtime-mode.sh` prints `RUNTIME_MODE=<claude|codex|split|invalid>` at SessionStart so the orchestrator no longer has to guess whether Codex owns the project — `invalid` halts instead of silently defaulting to `claude`, and `split` echoes the declared path partition (21 tests). CLAUDE.md's 작업 원칙 also gained a one-line model-recommendation step before every task, covering both the session model and any subagent's `model` param — advisory only, deferring to Route hint's "savings come from fewer calls, not a cheaper model" rule rather than overriding it. (v0.6.4 made the deterministic-gate contract survive the console it runs in; v0.6.3 closed four holes in the gate contract and added /remove-bg.)
